description:
Add a service to a budget category (category id from list_time_tracker_projects). Managers only. serviceType is one of seo, link_building, design, content, ppc, development; billingType is time_and_materials, fixed_fee or recurring; quantity is the budgeted hours (a decimal greater than 0). A category of another organization or property returns not_found. Available only on accounts with Time Tracker enabled.

Cost: 2 credits per call.

Examples:
```json
// add a 10-hour Technical SEO service to a category.
{"property":"sc-domain:example.com","category":"00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001","name":"Technical SEO","serviceType":"seo","billingType":"time_and_materials","quantity":"10"}
```
name: create_time_tracker_service

render_with.description: Render tool that can display this payload.

title: Create time tracker service
